focus: Verified 2026–2027 event, design-week, lecture, academic deadline and terminology sweep
methodology: Read current repository records before editing and check each candidate for matching names, URLs and editions.
Prefer official organizers, universities, professional societies and source publishers; avoid social profiles and speculative dates.
Keep no completed dated event in the active calendar; archive expired entries without removing their sources.
Write independent descriptions; retain source attribution and access conditions.
